def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    path = 'data/legal/input/csn-data-book-2024-csv/CSVs/2024_CSN_State_Top_Ten_Report_Categories.csv'

    # Raw preview shows: row0 title, row1 blank, row2 header.
    df = pd.read_csv(path, header=2)

    # Normalize column names (trim whitespace)
    df.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in df.columns]

    # Drop trailing source/blank rows
    for col in ['State', 'Category']:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = df[col].astype(str).str.strip()
    df = df.dropna(subset=['State', 'Category'])
    df = df[(df['State'] != 'nan') & (df['Category'] != 'nan')]

    return df
